#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

class FFT {
public:
    class Vector {
    public:
        static const int size = 1 << 20;
        long long v[size];

        Vector(const std::vector<long long>& a) {
            std::fill(v, v + size, 0);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < a.size(); i++) {
                v[i] = a[i];
            }
        }

        std::vector<long long> FFT() {
            return DFT(0, 1, true);
        }

        std::vector<long long> FFT1() {
            std::vector<long long> x = DFT(0, 1, false);
            for (size_t i = 0; i < x.size(); i++) {
                x[i] = (x[i] * szinv) % mod;
            }
            return x;
        }

        std::vector<long long> DFT(int start, int step, bool forward) {
            int n = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                if ((i & (size - 1)) == start) {
                    n++;
                }
            }
            if (step == size) {
                return {v[start]};
            }
            std::vector<long long> left = DFT(start, step * 2, forward);
            std::vector<long long> right = DFT(start + step, step * 2, forward);
            int len = (int)left.size();
            std::vector<long long> result(2 * len);
            for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
                long long val = (forward ? warr[i * step] : winvarr[i * step]) * right[i] % mod;
                result[i] = (left[i] + val) % mod;
                result[len + i] = ((left[i] - val) + mod) % mod;
            }
            return result;
        }
    };

    long long mod = 998244353;
    long long w = 646;
    long long winv;
    long long warr[1 << 20];
    long long winvarr[1 << 20];
    long long szinv;

    FFT() {
        // Compute modular inverse of w and size
        winv = modInverse(w, mod);
        szinv = modInverse((1 << 20), mod);
        for (int i = 1; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            warr[i] = (warr[i - 1] * w) % mod;
            winvarr[i] = (winvarr[i - 1] * w) % mod;
        }
        warr[0] = 1;
        winvarr[0] = 1;
    }

    long long modInverse(long long a, long long m) {
        return powMod(a, m - 2, m);
    }

    long long powMod(long long base, long long exp, long long m) {
        long long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % m;
            base = (base * base) % m;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    std::vector<long long> fftTransform(const std::vector<long long>& a) {
        std::vector<long long> ans((1 << 20), 0);
        long long wth = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); i++) {
            long long x = 1;
            for (size_t j = 0; j < a.size(); j++) {
                ans[i] = (ans[i] + a[j] * x) % mod;
                x = (x * wth) % mod;
            }
            wth = (wth * w) % mod;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    std::vector<long long> power(std::vector<long long>& array, int p) {
        for (size_t i = 0; i < array.size(); i++) {
            array[i] = powMod(array[i], p, mod);
        }
        return array;
    }

    void solve() {
        int n, k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        std::vector<long long> arr(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int val;
            cin >> val;
            arr[val] = 1;
        }
        std::vector<long long> x = fftTransform(arr);
        x = power(x, n / 2);
        Vector v(x);
        std::vector<long long> y = v.FFT1();
        long long ans = 0;
        for (size_t i = 0; i < y.size(); i++) {
            ans = (ans + y[i] * y[i]) % mod;
        }
        cout << ans << "\n";
    }

    void run() {
        ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
        cin.tie(nullptr);
        solve();
    }
};

int main() {
    FFT fft;
    fft.run();
    return 0;
}
